bounded_by: CPU-only, 7M-param model, 1M useful training tokens, 6 whole-work Project Gutenberg corpus, single seed 20260731.

scope: Under the P2 bounded real-English checkpoint (runs/aeon_lbc1_P2/final.pt), on the sealed TEST partition (PG-1661), the shared Recursion broadcast carries semantically relevant content for next-token prediction. Broadcast content matters (ZERO_BROADCAST +0.691 nat; NORM_MATCHED +0.710 nat), broadcast batch alignment does not (SHUFFLE +0.0001 nat), substrate source carries slightly more useful signal than transformer source (MASK_SUBSTRATE +0.051 vs MASK_TRANSFORMER +0.012).
